caption: Forte di Bard, Bard
composition: Terraced Alpine fortress climbing a gorge cliff above the Dora Baltea · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From across the gorge, the tourist faces the Forte di Bard climbing the cliff in terraced stone ramparts, its long barracks blocks stepping up the rock face to the summit. Bare cliffs and dark forest fill the right, while the Dora Baltea glints at the lower left and hazy mountains rise behind. The 11:20 sun is strong and direct, casting short shadows across the pale stonework.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Forte di Bard under morning light
